applies_to.quote: Master Direction – Reserve Bank of India (Relief Measures by Banks in Areas affected by Natural Calamities) Directions 2018 – SCBs

answer.action: No action is required as this notification repeals the existing relief measure directions for scheduled commercial banks and replaces them with alternative directions.
answer.action_quote: hereby repeals Master Direction – Reserve Bank of India (Relief Measures by Banks in Areas affected by Natural Calamities) Directions 2018 – SCBs dated October 17, 2018

effective_date.quote: The Directions shall be replaced with the following Directions issued on April 29, 2026, with effect from July 01, 2026.

answer.amends: Master Direction – Reserve Bank of India (Relief Measures by Banks in Areas affected by Natural Calamities) Directions 2018 – SCBs
